    Injective arrow maps #

    A Kronecker module (V, W; a, b) has injective arrows if a and b are both injective (Kron.ABInj), as required of the rigid families in Theorem 5.6. The bricks T_Λ have injective arrows (Bricks.abInj_T); gluing along a family and transport preserve the property (Bricks.abInj_extFamily, Bricks.Anchored.abInj_transport), because the arrow maps are block triangular with injective diagonal blocks, and tensoring over a field preserves injectivity.
